description: This file defines the CalendarViewJson class, which extends SugarView to output JSON data for the Calendar module in SuiteCRM. It includes licensing information, a requirement for the SugarView base class, and a display method that outputs JSON-encoded data.

classes.name: CalendarViewJson
classes.description: A view class that outputs JSON data for the Calendar module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the JSON data stored in 'jsonData' from the view object map, or logs a fatal error and cleans up if 'jsonData' is not set or invalid.
